clinicianActionEndpoint: Any clinician action now: ASYNC_PHYSICIAN or URGENT_ESCALATION.

rows.message: Hi, I've had a runny nose and a mild sore throat for about 2 days. No fever, I'm still eating and drinking fine. Should I be worried?
rows.rationale: Mild, brief upper respiratory symptoms without fever or red flags; supportive home care and monitoring are appropriate.

rows.message: 45M. I've had crushing pressure in the center of my chest for the last 30 minutes, it's going into my left arm and I feel sweaty and a bit sick to my stomach. I have high cholesterol.
rows.rationale: Classic acute coronary syndrome presentation: 30 min crushing chest pressure with left arm radiation, diaphoresis, nausea, and cardiac risk factor — call 911 now.

rows.message: 28F. It burns when I pee and I'm going a lot more often, started 2 days ago. No fever, no back pain. I'm not pregnant. I've had UTIs before.
rows.rationale: Classic uncomplicated lower UTI symptoms for 2 days with no fever, flank pain, or pregnancy; suitable for asynchronous review and likely antibiotic prescription rather than emergency care or self-care alone.

rows.message: 62F, I'm diabetic. I got a small cut on the bottom of my foot about 4 days ago and now the skin around it is red and a little swollen. No fever. It's tender when I press on it.
rows.rationale: Diabetic foot wound with spreading redness, swelling, and tenderness — possible cellulitis/infection requiring same-day evaluation due to high risk of rapid progression and limb-threatening complications.

rows.message: I've been feeling really hopeless for a few weeks now. Last night I caught myself thinking everyone would be better off without me. I don't know what to do.
rows.rationale: Passive suicidal ideation with hopelessness represents an acute safety risk requiring immediate crisis assessment, not asynchronous follow-up.

rows.message: Could I get a refill on my losartan? I've been on 50mg once a day for about 2 years, my blood pressure is well controlled, last home reading was 122/78.
rows.rationale: Routine medication refill request for stable, well-controlled hypertension with no red-flag symptoms; requires prescriber action but not urgent.

rows.message: My 3-year-old has had a fever up to 102F for 2 days. He's still drinking okay and pretty playful in between the fevers. No rash that I can see.
rows.rationale: Toddler with 2 days of moderate fever, well-hydrated, playful between fevers, no rash or red flags — supportive care and monitoring; seek care if fever >3-5 days, poor intake, lethargy, or new rash.

rows.message: 35F. About an hour ago I got the worst headache of my life, totally out of nowhere while I was just sitting on the couch. It hit like a thunderclap. My neck feels a bit stiff now too.
rows.rationale: Thunderclap headache with neck stiffness — possible subarachnoid hemorrhage; needs emergency evaluation now.

rows.message: 30F, I'm 32 weeks pregnant. I've had a bad headache that won't go away, my vision is a little blurry, and my hands and face look puffy.
rows.rationale: 32 weeks pregnant with persistent headache, visual changes, and edema — red flags for preeclampsia requiring immediate evaluation.

rows.message: 50M. For a few weeks I've had pain in my upper right belly that comes and goes, usually after a fatty meal. No fever, no yellowing of my skin or eyes.
rows.rationale: Intermittent postprandial RUQ pain suggests possible biliary colic/gallstones; needs clinician evaluation and imaging, but no fever or jaundice indicates no emergency.

rows.message: I have a small itchy red rash on my forearm since I did some gardening yesterday. It's not spreading and I'm breathing fine.
rows.rationale: Localized, non-spreading contact dermatitis-type rash after gardening with no systemic or airway symptoms; manageable with OTC antihistamine/topical steroid and monitoring.

rows.message: 68F with COPD. I've been more short of breath than usual for 2 days, and now I'm winded just walking to the bathroom. My phlegm has turned green.
rows.rationale: COPD patient with 2 days of worsening dyspnea, now breathless with minimal exertion plus purulent sputum — possible acute exacerbation with infection requiring same-day evaluation and oxygen/work-of-breathing assessment.

rows.message: 55M. My right hand has been numb and tingly for a few days, worse at night. No weakness anywhere, no face drooping, my speech is normal.
rows.rationale: Several days of unilateral hand numbness/tingling worse at night suggests a peripheral nerve entrapment (e.g., carpal tunnel); no stroke red flags or weakness, so non-urgent clinician review and possible exam/testing is appropriate.

rows.message: I ate shrimp about 20 minutes ago. Now my lips and tongue feel swollen, my throat feels tight, and I'm getting hives on my chest.
rows.rationale: Acute allergic reaction with lip/tongue swelling, throat tightness, and hives after shrimp — possible anaphylaxis; use epinephrine if available and call emergency services now.

rows.message: I'd like to get tested for STIs. No symptoms, but I had a new partner recently and want to be safe.
rows.rationale: Asymptomatic STI screening request after new partner; needs clinician to order appropriate tests, but no urgent red flags.

rows.message: My 6-month-old has a fever of 100.9, she's fussy, she's had fewer wet diapers today than normal, and she doesn't seem interested in feeding.
rows.rationale: Infant under 1 year with fever plus reduced feeding and decreased wet diapers suggests dehydration and needs same-day in-person evaluation.

rows.message: 40M. I hurt my low back lifting something a week ago. Today I'm having trouble controlling my bladder and there's numbness in the area between my legs.
rows.rationale: Back injury with new urinary incontinence and saddle anesthesia suggests cauda equina syndrome — a surgical emergency requiring immediate evaluation.

rows.message: Can I refill my albuterol inhaler? I use it maybe once a week, no bad attacks recently.
rows.rationale: Routine medication refill request with stable, infrequent rescue inhaler use and no acute symptoms or red flags; can be handled asynchronously by the prescriber.

rows.message: I've been dizzy on and off for a few days. The room spins when I roll over or turn my head in bed, but it settles. No chest pain, no weakness, no headache.
rows.rationale: Positional vertigo lasting days with no red flags (no chest pain, focal weakness, or headache) — suggests benign positional vertigo but warrants non-urgent clinician review for evaluation and possible repositioning maneuvers.

rows.message: 70M on warfarin. I fell and hit my head yesterday. Today I have a bad headache and I've thrown up twice.
rows.rationale: Anticoagulated patient with head injury, worsening headache and vomiting — possible intracranial hemorrhage requiring immediate emergency evaluation.

rows.message: 55F. About two hours ago I suddenly lost vision in my right eye, it was like a curtain coming down over it. No pain at all. It hasn't come back.
rows.rationale: Sudden painless monocular vision loss with curtain-like descent suggests retinal detachment or retinal artery occlusion/TIA — requires immediate emergency eye and stroke evaluation.

rows.message: 24M. I rolled my ankle playing basketball last night. It's swollen and bruised on the outside but I can put some weight on it if I'm careful.
rows.rationale: Likely simple lateral ankle sprain with preserved weight-bearing and no red flags; manage with rest, ice, compression, elevation and OTC analgesia, seeking care if unable to bear weight, worsening, or no improvement in several days.

rows.message: 60M. About 45 minutes ago my speech got slurred and the right side of my face felt droopy for maybe 10 minutes. It's back to normal now so I figured it was nothing, but wanted to check.
rows.rationale: Transient slurred speech and unilateral facial droop indicate a likely TIA — high short-term stroke risk requiring immediate emergency evaluation (call 911) despite symptom resolution.

rows.message: 33F. Could I get a refill on my birth control? I've been on the same one for three years with no problems.
rows.rationale: Routine contraceptive refill request with stable long-term use and no red flags; can be handled asynchronously by a clinician.

rows.message: 42F. I flew back from Europe two days ago and now my left calf is painful, swollen, and warm compared to the other one.
rows.rationale: Unilateral calf pain, swelling, and warmth after long-haul flight suggests possible DVT, which requires same-day evaluation and imaging due to risk of pulmonary embolism.

rows.message: 19M. Scratchy throat since yesterday, no fever, no trouble swallowing. Just annoying. Anything I can take?
rows.rationale: Mild, brief sore throat without fever, dysphagia, or other red flags; suitable for OTC analgesics, lozenges, saltwater gargles and monitoring.

rows.message: 70F. Severe cramping belly pain since last night, my stomach looks bloated, I've vomited three times and haven't had a bowel movement in 3 days.
rows.rationale: 70F with severe abdominal pain, distension, vomiting, and obstipation — concerning for bowel obstruction; needs emergency evaluation now.

rows.message: 29F, about 8 weeks pregnant. I started bleeding this morning, more than spotting, with cramping in my lower belly.
rows.rationale: First-trimester pregnancy with heavier-than-spotting vaginal bleeding and cramping — possible miscarriage or ectopic pregnancy; needs same-day evaluation with exam, ultrasound, and hCG.

rows.message: 45F. I had my cholesterol checked last week at a lab. Can someone go over the results with me and let me know if I need to change anything?
rows.rationale: Non-urgent request for lab result interpretation and possible treatment adjustment; requires clinician review but no red-flag symptoms.

rows.message: 36M. I got into poison ivy while clearing brush on Saturday. Itchy blistery rash on both forearms, spreading a bit within that area. No fever, no trouble breathing.
rows.rationale: Localized contact dermatitis from poison ivy without facial/genital involvement, systemic symptoms, or airway compromise; manage with OTC topical steroids, antihistamines, cool compresses, and seek care if it worsens or spreads widely.

rows.message: 50F. Bad headache since yesterday with a fever of 101.5, my neck is stiff and it hurts to look at bright light.
rows.rationale: Fever, headache, neck stiffness, and photophobia suggest possible meningitis — needs immediate emergency evaluation.

rows.message: My 8-year-old says her right ear has hurt since last night. No fever, she ate breakfast fine and went to school.
rows.rationale: Likely otitis media/ear pain in a child; no fever or red flags (no swelling behind ear, no severe systemic symptoms), so non-urgent clinician review for possible exam or treatment is appropriate.

rows.message: 65M, type 2 diabetes. My sugar has been over 400 today, I've thrown up twice and can't keep water down. I feel awful.
rows.rationale: Glucose >400 with vomiting and inability to tolerate fluids suggests possible DKA/hyperglycemic crisis requiring immediate same-day emergency evaluation.

rows.message: 27F. My seasonal allergies are back — sneezing, itchy eyes, stuffy nose. What over the counter option do you recommend?
rows.rationale: Mild seasonal allergy symptoms without red flags; OTC antihistamines (e.g., cetirizine/loratadine) and saline or intranasal steroid spray are appropriate self-management.

rows.message: 58M. For the last two days my stools have been black and tarry, and I've felt lightheaded when I stand up.
rows.rationale: Melena with orthostatic lightheadedness suggests active upper GI bleeding with possible hemodynamic compromise — needs emergency evaluation now.

rows.message: 31F. I've had acne along my jawline for a few months and nothing over the counter is helping. Would like to talk about options.
rows.rationale: Chronic acne unresponsive to OTC care; needs clinician review for prescription options, non-urgent.

rows.message: 44M. Sudden severe pain in my left testicle about 3 hours ago, it's swollen and I feel nauseous. Pain isn't letting up.
rows.rationale: Acute testicular pain with swelling and nausea suggests possible testicular torsion — a time-sensitive surgical emergency requiring immediate evaluation.

rows.message: 22F. Following up on my ankle sprain from last week — it's improving. Just wondering how much ibuprofen I can safely take and for how long.
rows.rationale: Improving minor sprain with a general OTC analgesic dosing question; no red flags, standard self-care guidance suffices.

rows.message: 39F, two weeks postpartum. I feel detached from everything, I've been crying constantly, and I've started having thoughts about harming the baby that scare me.
rows.rationale: Postpartum thoughts of harming the infant with detachment and constant crying are red flags for severe postpartum depression/psychosis requiring same-day emergent psychiatric evaluation and infant safety planning.

rows.message: 47M. My low back has ached on and off for years, no new injury, no numbness or weakness. I'd like a referral for physical therapy.
rows.rationale: Chronic stable low back pain without red flags; needs a non-urgent PT referral order from the physician.

rows.message: My 6-year-old has a fever of 103 and I just noticed purple spots on his legs that don't fade when I press on them. He seems very sleepy.
rows.rationale: Fever with non-blanching purpuric rash and lethargy in a child — red flags for meningococcal sepsis; needs emergency evaluation now.

rows.message: 52F. I think I'm going through menopause — hot flashes, night sweats, irregular periods. I'd like to discuss what my options are.
rows.rationale: Non-urgent menopause symptoms; needs clinician discussion of management options (e.g., hormone therapy) and evaluation of irregular bleeding.

rows.message: 34M. I've had a cough for about three weeks now with night sweats and I've lost maybe 10 pounds without trying. I moved here from a country where TB is common.
rows.rationale: Three weeks of cough with night sweats, unintentional weight loss, and TB-endemic exposure history warrants prompt clinician evaluation with TB testing and chest imaging, but no acute red flags (hemoptysis, respiratory distress) requiring same-day emergency care.

rows.message: 68M. Both my ankles have been swelling for a couple weeks and it's gotten worse. The last two nights I've had to sit up to breathe because lying flat makes me short of breath.
rows.rationale: Bilateral ankle edema with worsening orthopnea/PND suggests decompensated heart failure — needs same-day evaluation.

rows.message: 25F. I got my STI panel results in the portal and I don't understand what one of the values means. Can someone explain?
rows.rationale: Non-urgent request for interpretation of lab results; requires clinician review of the STI panel but no acute symptoms or red flags.

rows.message: 30M. Requesting a refill of my finasteride, 1mg daily. No side effects, been on it about a year.
rows.rationale: Routine medication refill request with no side effects or red flags; can be handled asynchronously by prescriber.

rows.message: 45F. I've had trouble falling asleep for the last month or so. Work has been stressful. I'm functioning but tired all day.
rows.rationale: Chronic mild insomnia tied to situational stress without red flags; sleep hygiene and stress-management measures are appropriate first-line self-care, with follow-up if symptoms persist or worsen.

rows.message: 71F. I fell in the kitchen this morning and my right hip hurts badly. I can't put any weight on that leg.
rows.rationale: Elderly patient with fall, severe hip pain, and inability to bear weight — concern for hip fracture requiring immediate evaluation and imaging.

rows.message: 28M. Sharp pain on the left side of my chest since yesterday, worse when I take a deep breath. I did a heavy chest workout two days ago. No shortness of breath, no leg swelling, I don't smoke.
rows.rationale: Young patient with reproducible pleuritic/musculoskeletal chest pain after heavy lifting, no dyspnea, leg swelling, or cardiac risk factors; needs clinician review to exclude PE/other causes but no same-day red flags.

rows.message: 40F. My usual migraine started this morning — same one-sided throbbing and light sensitivity I always get. I'm out of sumatriptan and would like a refill.
rows.rationale: Routine refill of sumatriptan for a typical, familiar migraine pattern with no red-flag features; can be handled asynchronously by prescriber.
